title: Size of the move (3/4): scoping writes the size record, proven by a pre-registered replay
description:
## As asked

Piece 3 of 4 of LIN-4346 ("Deciding the size of the move becomes part of the run"). Lands after piece 2 (it writes the record piece 2 defines and guards). Piece 4 must not start unless this piece's replay passes.

**Why.** Sizing belongs to scoping: it already decides what gets delivered, and since LIN-4345 its CUT rule names each cut and raises one ruling. A separate size stage would be a second owner of delivery scope. Before anything routes tickets to it automatically, it has to be shown on past tickets that the written size carries no how, and that a small, clear ticket stays small under "err larger".

**This piece's slice of the approved plan**

* **Scoping's output becomes the size record.** It reads both Survey comments, the area notes and Periodical readings where they exist (today: nowhere; LIN-4347 owns notes, and `/periodicals` returns run state, not readings), filing comments, and for a breakdown child, the parent's record. It reads a person's size comment already on the trail as that person's ruling and records it as decided by a ruling. It lays out the sizes from just the task to wrong work and recommends one; "just the task" is as easy to recommend as anything and is the answer whenever the Surveys find nothing this task binds on. With a standing policy (rendered by code) it applies it and says so; without one it records "pending a ruling" and raises the size as a `DECISION:`. A size smaller than asked, or wrong work, is a cut under CUT, with no second rule; a policy never authorizes a cut.
* Remove scoping's separate In/Out/Assumptions/Success block: success is plan's Done-when; cuts and open questions live in the record. Update scoping's completion signals. Record prompt growth beside the ceiling it raises (piece 1's shape).
* **Replay, pre-registered before any run.** Commit the pre-registration (pass criteria fixed) first. Tickets: LIN-4178 (wording invited a copy), LIN-4252 (a tidy that left copies), LIN-4253 (a tidy that didn't), LIN-998 as the small, clear control. One Survey pair per ticket rendered at that ticket's historical base and with the ticket text as filed (the Survey prompts otherwise resolve `origin/main` and embed today's description via `formatSurveyTicketText`); then three scoping runs per ticket under `err-larger`. Reuse `scripts/survey-replay-*.mjs`, `scripts/steady-base-render*.mjs`, and LIN-4345's render path. Commit no new runnable scripts under `docs/reviews`; record the commands in the results doc.
* **Pass criteria** (fix them in the pre-registration), judged by a fresh session that built none of this: LIN-998 is "just the task" with no extra, 3/3; every record passes the piece-2 guard; on LIN-4178/4252/4253 no record tells the builder how (no list of names to sweep, no wording a builder could copy into code or turn into a comment); every size that cuts the ask raises a `DECISION:`.
* If the replay fails: stop, report on LIN-4346, and do not begin piece 4.

**Testing strategy / witness:** unit tests for the template changes (completion signals, policy and no-policy rendering, CUT still rendered once); the replay evidence kept lean: pre-registration, rendered prompts, outputs, a results doc with the fresh reader's verdict.

**Session fit:** fits one session.

**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4346's approving plan-review (comment d71c7085-b2ad-4760-8070-53bc917f9a1f, rev 1).

**Grounding commit:** `11dc1d7bd` (`origin/main` when the plan was written and reviewed; still `origin/main` at breakdown, 7 Nov 22:45 UTC).

**Starting point:** LIN-4346's approved plan is this piece's starting point. Read it in full in LIN-4346's description under `## Implementation Plan` (revision 1), with the builder notes in the approving verdict (comment d71c7085, 22:42). Read LIN-4346's `## As asked` block for the person's words and John's comment of 22:18 for the size ruling (err larger). Follow the plan; where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so on LIN-4346.

*End of what was asked. Steps write below this line; nothing above it changes.*

## Outcome (close-out, 2026-11-08)

Implemented and merged: PR [#2356](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2356>), merge commit `d294a190`, deployed (production on `ab942e80`). Scoping now writes the four-line size record (Size / Why / Cuts / Decided by) and posts no comment. The proxy guard holds the record's shape.

The plan was followed with deviations John ruled for. Arms 1–3 of the replay failed. Arm 4 passed all pre-registered conditions (`docs/reviews/lin-4369-size-replay-arm4-2026-11-08.md`). The record narrowed to the fixed four lines, and the control moved from LIN-998 to LIN-1512 (rulings `lin4346-size-after-arm2`, `lin4369-park-vs-arm3`, `lin4369-after-arm3`).

Two post-deploy live-record checks (review ledger items 2 and 3) were not run, because no live scoping record exists yet. They are listed on PR #2356 and LIN-4370. The full history is kept in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Review — LIN-4369

PR [#2356](https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2356), head `99c542198d390e45a3fad9ab61f71457be81c073`. The branch is level with `origin/main` (`110e35e0`, 0 commits behind) and mergeable.

CI: green on `99c54219` (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success). Locally, the 5 suites this change touches pass 89/89.

### Against what was asked, sentence by sentence
- **Sizing belongs to scoping, with no second owner.** Met. Scoping's process now writes the record, and there is no new stage.
- **Reads both Surveys, notes and readings where they exist, filing comments, and a breakdown child's parent record.** Met in the prompt: `SURVEY_HEADINGS` is one constant used by both Survey templates and by scoping. Notes and readings are read "where they exist". The area-notes pointer is deliberately left off (see Leftovers).
- **A person's size comment is their ruling.** Met in the prompt ("record it as decided by a ruling").
- **Lays out the sizes and recommends one; "just the task" is as easy to recommend, and is the answer when nothing binds.** The prompt does this ("Weigh the sizes and recommend one…"). The weighed sizes are no longer written into the record. That narrowing is agreed by John's `structural-arm` ruling (3f501043 / 17341841): "record is a fixed size plus one sentence why, cuts, who decided".
- **With a policy, apply it and say so; without one, "pending a ruling" plus a `DECISION:`.** Met in the prompt, and unit-tested for both renders (`policy and no-policy rendering`). The no-policy path has only render tests (ledger 3).
- **A smaller size or wrong work is a cut under CUT, with no second rule; a policy never authorizes a cut.** CUT renders once (tested). The guard refuses wrong work decided by the standing policy. A *named* cut decided by the standing policy is still accepted (ledger 2).
- **Remove In/Out/Assumptions/Success; update completion signals; record prompt growth beside the ceiling.** Met. Open questions no longer live in the record, which the same structural ruling agrees to. The growth comments need a fix (finding F1).
- **Replay pre-registered; four tickets; Survey pair at the historical base; 3 runs each under err-larger; reuse the scripts; no runnable scripts under `docs/reviews`.** Met:
